intent: Require GitHub receipts for all work, code, assets, artifacts, handoffs and closure packs, and define when a chat thread can close after Pen handoff.

policy.name: GITHUB_RECEIPT_REQUIRED_FOR_ALL_WORK
policy.completion_rule: Do not classify work as closed unless a GitHub receipt exists. If runtime work is required, a runtime receipt or failure receipt is also required.
policy.thread_closure_rule: Once the work package has been passed to the Pen and the GitHub/Pen receipt has been posted back into the chat thread, the job of that chat thread is done and the thread can close. Downstream execution continues in the Pen/Bridge/runtime layer and must produce runtime receipts where required.
policy.pending_rule: If only a Pen inbox enqueue exists and no runtime receipt exists, the chat thread may close as HANDOFF_COMPLETE when the user-requested unit of work was handoff to Pen. The downstream workload remains PARTIAL_NOT_CLOSED until runtime receipt or failure receipt exists.

classification_split.thread_state: HANDOFF_COMPLETE once GitHub/Pen receipt is posted in-thread
classification_split.runtime_state: PARTIAL_NOT_CLOSED until runtime receipt or failure receipt exists

actions_requested: Register this as a standing Pen and Bridge closure rule.
Apply it to future work packages.
Apply it to the T4H Comms Hub Level 1.0 handoff.
